# Notepad User Guide

## Overview
Notepad is a simple text editor included with Windows. It allows you to create, open, edit, and save text files.

## Creating a New Document

To create a new document in Notepad:
1. Click the "File" menu in the top-left corner
2. Select "New" from the dropdown menu
3. A blank document will appear
4. You can start typing immediately

## Opening an Existing File

To open an existing file:
1. Click the "File" menu
2. Select "Open" from the dropdown
3. Browse to your file location
4. Select the file and click "Open"
5. The file content will appear in the editor

## Saving Your Work

To save your document:
1. Click the "File" menu
2. Select "Save" to save with the current filename
3. Or select "Save As" to save with a new filename
4. Choose the location and filename
5. Click "Save"

## Basic Text Editing

### Typing Text
Simply click in the text area and start typing. The cursor will appear where you click.

### Selecting Text
- Click and drag to select text
- Double-click to select a word
- Triple-click to select a line
- Ctrl+A to select all text

### Copying and Pasting
- Select text, then Ctrl+C to copy
- Click where you want to paste, then Ctrl+V to paste
- Or use the "Edit" menu for Copy and Paste options

## Formatting Options

### Word Wrap
1. Click the "Format" menu
2. Select "Word Wrap"
3. Toggle it on or off

### Font Selection
1. Click the "Format" menu
2. Select "Font"
3. Choose your desired font, size, and style
4. Click "OK"

## Finding and Replacing Text

### Find Text
1. Click the "Edit" menu
2. Select "Find" (or Ctrl+F)
3. Type the text you want to find
4. Click "Find Next" to search

### Replace Text
1. Click the "Edit" menu
2. Select "Replace" (or Ctrl+H)
3. Type the text to find and the replacement text
4. Click "Replace" or "Replace All"

## Printing

To print your document:
1. Click the "File" menu
2. Select "Print"
3. Choose your printer settings
4. Click "Print"

## Keyboard Shortcuts

- Ctrl+N: New document
- Ctrl+O: Open file
- Ctrl+S: Save
- Ctrl+F: Find
- Ctrl+H: Replace
- Ctrl+A: Select all
- Ctrl+C: Copy
- Ctrl+V: Paste
- Ctrl+X: Cut
